facts.fact: Approximately 75% of US adults celebrated Father's Day in 2023, according to the National Retail Federation (NRF).
facts.quote: Approximately 75% of US adults celebrated the occasion in 2023, according to the National Retail Federation

facts.fact: The average expected spend on a Father's Day gift per consumer was a record $196.23 USD, up from $171.79 the previous year.
facts.quote: The average expected spend on a Father’s Day gift per consumer was a record $196.23 USD, up from $171.79 last year.

facts.fact: Consumer spending on Father's Day was expected to reach a record $22.9 billion USD, up from $20 billion USD the previous year, according to NRF's annual consumer survey.
facts.quote: Consumer spending over will reach a record $22.9 billion USD, up from last year’s $20 billion USD

facts.fact: The top Father's Day gifts to give in 2023 were greeting cards, clothes, and special outings, according to NRF's report.
facts.quote: The top gifts to give in 2023 were greeting cards, clothes, and special outings.

facts.fact: Nearly one-third of Father's Day gift givers were planning to give an experience gift, such as sporting event or concert tickets, up 25% from the previous year according to NRF.
facts.quote: In fact, nearly one-third are planning to give a gift of experience, such as tickets to a sporting event or a concert. That is up 25% from last year

facts.fact: US retail e-commerce revenue was estimated at roughly $905 billion USD in 2022.
facts.quote: Revenue from retail e-commerce in the US was estimated at roughly $905 billion USD in 2022.

facts.fact: Statista's Digital Market Outlook forecasts that US online shopping revenue will exceed $1.7 trillion by 2027.
facts.quote: online shopping revenue in the US will exceed $1.7 trillion dollars.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that digital out-of-home (DOOH) ads are not subject to privacy regulations because they do not use or collect cookies.
facts.quote: DOOH is not subject to privacy regulations because it doesn’t use or collect cookies
